cost_value.principle: Full acquisition and future-verification time governs value.

development_controls.principle: Exhaustive small-domain audits permit no wrong binary admission.

no_infeasible_output.principle: Every returned future plan needs an exact final acceptance.

qualified_upstream.principle: The same-milestone executor fixture must be terminal and readiness-qualified.

resource_bounds.principle: Every arm must respect the query and durable-state caps.

sealed_manifests.principle: Public and private seals must replay.

terminal_validation.principle: Independent and strict readers must pass.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: List actual intended model identities; this run intends no model work.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each gate records expected, observed, passed and its principle.
field_principles.acquisition_manifest_path: New evaluation contexts remain unopened until the method is frozen.
field_principles.acquisition_protocol: Seal arity, finite bias, exact oracle semantics, caps and controls.
field_principles.acquisition_prototype_ready_score: A sound bounded prototype permits measurement, not a speed claim.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic time; never wait merely to pass a duration floor.
field_principles.execution_venue: Use host; this milestone makes no new board-execution claim.
field_principles.field_principles: Explain fields separately; do not wrap numeric gates or ordinary dictionaries.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: Set false only after current verification; a critical finding prevents promotion.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* names upstream, failed check, exact artifact field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed work starts complete_ or complete:; external absence starts blocked_ with its failed check.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declare actual computation; historical model receipts are not current inference.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use the closed duration class matching the actual run.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted, completed, failed, cancelled and in-flight operations.
field_principles.model_invoked: True for any attempted current model load or generation, including failures.
field_principles.phase_spans: Measure disjoint load, generation, evaluation, test and write spans.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record each actual input/resource check before dependent work.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze development, evaluation and resampling seeds before outcomes.
field_principles.repository_health: Preserve dated unrelated failures separately from affected required validation.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, settings, inputs, evaluator identity and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Keep every comparative unit, arm, metric, cost, failure and censoring disposition.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260916; record real UTC timestamps as well.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, completed and censored units and stopping rules.
field_principles.schema: Version the record and retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate exact producers and current same-milestone paths.
field_principles.status: Write a terminal result only after actual work and affected checks.
field_principles.unsupported_controls: Record unsupported scope without converting it to binary certainty.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain exact command, scope, exit code, elapsed time and log hash, including failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Closed enum: positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when the executor defines correctness; separate code does not remove circularity.
